issues.location: scripts/phase-lock.sh cmd_claim (age = now - hb; no future-timestamp bound); .phase-locks.json not gitignored
issues.problem: A repository can commit .planning/.phase-locks.json with last_heartbeat_at in the future (e.g. 2099). age is then negative and the lock is never stale, so the PreToolUse claim hook blocks (exit 2) every Edit of that phase's files for every user. This is a persistent repository-content DoS, reachable downstream now that the plugin ships the helper. It is recoverable: the message names the lock, and the user can delete the file.
issues.evidence: REVF-G4-r3-probe/p-future.sh: committed lock {"001":{...last_heartbeat_at:"2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}; Edit payload | hooks/phase-lock-claim.sh -> '🚫 PHASE LOCK CONFLICT — phase 001 is locked by claude (owner_id=claude-other-1)', rc=2.
issues.suggested_fix: Follow-up: treat a heartbeat more than a small skew (e.g. 300 s) in the future as stale, and have /sb:init gitignore .planning/.phase-locks.json*.
